title: Declaration of Algorithmic Symbiosis
introduction:

This declaration describes the algorithmic layer that precedes every human intervention within the Plocos ecosystem.

sections.heading: Declaration of Algorithmic Symbiosis (Radical Transparency)
sections.body:
[EN: TODO legal review by Colombian attorney]

The first line of defence of this canon is an artificial intelligence engine calibrated to detect logical fallacies and argumentative deficiencies. For an argument to be evaluated by the author, it must first demonstrate structural perfection before the machine. This automated symbiosis legitimises the intellectual rigour of the project and prevents the sociological fraud derived from the volume of interactions.
